artworks.title: La Blanche Caroline (Pale Caroline)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground), and roulette or rocker (along the top margin) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a figure near a castle-like structure amid a dark setting. The central image is surrounded by various etched illustrations and decorative elements, including birds and floral motifs, framed within an abstract design. The drawing depicts a castle with a turret, bare trees, and a cloudy night sky. There is a sense of movement from the figure suggesting dynamism in the narrative. The surrounding area has sketches of flora and partially drawn figures, intertwining with the border design.

artworks.title: Ryno et Hermangarde
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, softground etching, salt lift, aquatint (spirit ground) and roulette in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a person riding a horse in a dynamic landscape. The central illustration shows a person riding a galloping horse across a rugged terrain or shoreline with expressive, swirling strokes. The background is richly textured, with abstract patterns and illustrations, including sketches of figures and a ship mast with birds. The composition conveys a feeling of urgency and dynamism, with swirling lines and contrasting dark and light patches suggesting movement and chaos.

artworks.title: Le Bas-Hamet
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a snowy village scene with various sketches around it. In the center, there is a snowy village street with houses and a figure. The sky above is depicted as heavy and dark. Surrounding the central scene are various delicate sketches of figures and forms, adding a dreamlike quality. The margins of the paper are filled with lightly sketched figures, possibly representing imaginative or spiritual elements.

artworks.title: Le Tombeau du Diable (The Devil's Tomb)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (spirit ground) and roulette (lower right margin, above the girl's head) in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image features an engraving depicting two figures, one male and one female, positioned in the center. The male figure is shown kneeling and leaning toward the sitting female figure. The female has long hair drawn back and appears to be dressed in a flowing garment, while the male figure is more difficult to describe due to the darkness surrounding him. No notable facial expression is discernible from the female's face due to the etching's shading. They are enclosed within what seems to be a cavern with rugged walls, and a torch illuminating the space from a sconce on the wall, casting shadows around them. Surrounding this central image is an intricately etched border with mythical and abstract figures, including a creature with a human head and a lion's body and other suggestive forms blending into the design.

artworks.title: Un Grain à Trouville (Squall at Trouville)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a beach scene with a crowd under parasols on the sandy shore. In the background, there are flags on tall poles. The sky above has expressive brushstrokes and swirling clouds. The color palette is sepia tones and black. Details like chairs show the shoreline's edge.

artworks.title: Le retour des artistes (The Return of the Artists)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and roulette in black on thin Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined urban street on a rainy day. The trees line the street creating a canopy. Three figures stand on the pavement, two holding umbrellas. In the middle, there is a horse-drawn carriage with people crossing the wet road. The painting style is etching with a sketch-like quality. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of grey and black, creating a moody atmosphere. The wet street reflects light, adding to the sense of rain, while blurred figures and trees suggest movement in the city.

artworks.title: La Fête nationale au Boulevard Clichy (National Holiday on the Boulevard de Clichy)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, stop-out, foul-bite, and softground etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban scene. The central image shows a bustling street with a prominent lamp post dividing the scene. The street features figures in Victorian-era attire, a small dog, and buildings draped in flags. The image is surrounded by a border showing scenes of carriages, riders on horseback, and leisure activities. The style of the drawing evokes urban life with social interactions and a festive atmosphere.

artworks.title: L'Hiver à Paris (Winter in Paris)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, spit-bite etching, softground etching, drypoint, and scraping in black on artificial vellum
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level perspective of a bustling urban scene. The horizon is not distinctly visible, and the focus is on the busy street with tall buildings lining it. The art style uses a sketch-like technique with brushstrokes, giving the scene a dynamic quality. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and beige, with snow on the ground. Figures and dogs are seen on the street, and the scene extends into the distance where the street converges towards a vanishing point. Horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians are visible in the busy city setting.

artworks.title: La Place Pigalle en 1878 (Place Pigalle in 1878)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and roulette with burnishing in brown-black and brown-red on vellum
artworks.description: The image shows a city square at street level. Buildings and chimneys dominate the horizon against a softly rendered sky. In the center, a horse-drawn carriage moves on the cobblestone street, surrounded by people. Near a building labeled "Tout Paris," individuals are busy with various activities. A group of people is gathered near a fountain-like structure, with two women sharing an umbrella. The color palette is mainly sepia and earthy tones, evoking a vintage atmosphere. The scene is detailed, with additional buildings and people extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Chaumières anglaises (English Cottages)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, sulphur tint, and softground etching in black on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a variety of lines and shapes layered over each other. Dark parallel lines and scattered crosshatchings create an abstract composition. There are dome-like shapes in the upper half of the image, along with lighter fragmented lines suggesting reflections or distant outlines.

artworks.title: La Traversée (The Passage)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint and stop-out in brown-black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of scenes on a ship. The central panel shows figures on the ship's deck looking out towards the horizon. The sky is cloudy. The left panel shows an ethereal figure in the clouds with a small animal below. The lower panel shows several figures seated closely together, some wrapped in blankets. The drawing presents different activities aboard a ship through small vignettes.

artworks.title: La Traversée (The Passage)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and softground etching (?) in black on laid paper
artworks.description:
This drawing depicts various scenes on a ship. The artwork is divided into multiple panels, each showing different vignettes. 

The upper section shows figures under umbrellas in the rain, with ships sailing in the background under a cloudy sky. The central panel displays figures walking upstairs on a deck, with umbrellas and the ship's structure creating depth. A smaller panel to the left shows a figure with an umbrella and a dog on a rainy day at the port. The bottom left corner depicts an impressionistic scene of figures, possibly children. The lower right panel shows seated figures on the deck, interacting or resting. 

The drawing uses a monochromatic scheme and sketch-like quality focusing on contrast and form.

artworks.title: L'Orage (The Storm)
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette with isolated areas of etching and possibly salt lift in black, touched in pen and black ink with gray wash, on moderately thick cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is faint and misty in the upper third of the image, with possible structures in the distance. The brushstrokes are varied and expressive, creating depth and movement. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. The terrain is rugged and uneven with dark patches. In the distance, the landscape stretches outward with blurred details. On the left side, there are sketches of faces and abstract shapes.

artworks.title: L'Orage (The Storm)
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette with isolated areas of etching and possibly salt lift in black on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a view from a slight elevation. The horizon is visible just above the center of the image, dividing the land from the sky filled with clouds. There are cattle grazing in the foreground, and the scene is depicted with varied brushstrokes in a sepia color palette. In the distance, there is a cluster of trees to the right, creating a sense of open space.

artworks.title: Liseuse à la Lampe (Woman Reading by Lamplight)
artworks.medium: etching with scraping and burnishing in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This image shows a person seated on a wooden chair, reading a book. They are slightly hunched forward, with their face obscured by darkness. The person has medium-length hair and wears a long garment that covers them fully. A table lamp behind them emits a soft glow, illuminating the immediate area. The room is dimly lit, with textured walls and dark wooden surfaces, creating an intimate and quiet ambiance.

artworks.title: La Place des Martyrs et La Taverne du Bagne (The Place des Martyrs and the Jailhouse Tavern)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, lift-ground aquatint, drypoint, roulette, and burnishing in brown-black, with selective wiping, on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban scene with the illumination of the "Taverne du Bagne" dominating the foreground. The surrounding area is filled with tall buildings and a crowd of people socializing near the taverne. The artwork features intricate line work and cross-hatching techniques, creating depth and texture through expressive brushstrokes. The color scheme is primarily brown and sepia, giving a vintage feel, with silhouettes of people against the building's lights. In the background, dense urban architecture can be seen with windows and signs, and bare trees are visible on the sides.

artworks.title: La Place des Martyrs et La Taverne du Bagne (The Place des Martyrs and the Jailhouse Tavern)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, lift-ground aquatint, drypoint, roulette, and burnishing in brown-black, with selective wiping (particularly in the bank of windows), on cream laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a night street scene outside a tavern. The drawing depicts a crowded urban setting with a prominent tavern sign that reads "TAVERNE DU BAGNE" illuminated against a backdrop of dark, looming buildings. The scene is set at night, creating a contrast between the shadows of the surrounding structures and the brightness emanating from the tavern. A large group of people are gathered in the foreground, appearing as silhouettes against the luminous background. The setting is framed by sketch-like borders featuring various etchings and text at the bottom, adding detail to the drawing. This drawing is done in the style of late 19th-century etching.

artworks.title: La Falaise: Baie de Saint-Malo (The Cliff: Saint-Malo Bay)
artworks.medium: heliogravure, etching, drypoint, roulette, and aquatint in gray-green (central plate) and black (margin plate) on wove paper
artworks.description: This etching depicts a coastal scene with a wide view. The horizon line separates the sky from the sea. In the distance, small figures are suggested. The style uses fine lines and has a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and brown. The rocky coastline slopes towards the water, showing rough textures. The sky features textured clouds.

artworks.title: Le Château des hiboux (Castle of the Owls)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and roulette in black on 18th-century cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an arrangement of lines and shapes that form an abstract composition. On the left side, there is a circular area enclosing dark, indistinct shapes. On the right side, an intricate design reminiscent of a bookplate is filled with detailed illustrations, including a sailing ship and musical notes, as well as a violin and an open book. The word "EXLIBRIS" is inscribed at the top.

artworks.title: Le Château des hiboux (Castle of the Owls)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, roulette, stop-out, sulphur tint, and crayon stop-out in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features two sections. On the left, there is a circular vignette showing a grayscale landscape with a body of water reflecting light, a castle in the distance under a crescent moon and stars, and distant glowing dots. The right section displays an ornate ex libris design with intricate illustrations including figures, a ship, and a musical score, all in monochromatic tones. The left side has a hazy and mysterious quality with soft brushstrokes, while the right side has finer line work and deeper shadows.

artworks.title: Chaumière de pêcheur (Fisherman's Cottage)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper with central image on chine collé
artworks.description: The image features a landscape scene with a central rustic building on the left side. The horizon line is visible just above the center, depicting a vast land with a gray-toned sky. The painting is predominantly in black, white, and shades of gray. Surrounding the central scene are sketched vignettes including small figures, structures, and a person in a boat at the bottom edge.

artworks.title: The Victoria Clock Tower London
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a busy street scene with a focus on Big Ben, the clock tower to the left. The horizon is suggested by the street and buildings. The painting has soft brushstrokes creating a misty atmosphere. The color palette is mainly shades of gray, with light contrasts between the sky, street, and figures. The street is filled with carriages, pedestrians, and street lamps that blend into the urban scene.

artworks.title: Montmartre le 14 Juillet (Bastille Day in Montmartre)
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph with added crayon, ink, scraping, and stumping on the stone in black on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays an urban landscape from a slightly elevated perspective, featuring a cityscape with a moody atmosphere. The horizon is high, showing architectural structures and rooftops against a misty sky. Distant buildings merge with the surrounding gloom. The painting has loose and expressive brushwork, with soft and smudged strokes creating a hazy quality. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, gray, and white. Closer elements show indistinct forms of buildings and rooftops, adding to the dense scene. Background details are more abstract, blending into a textured sky.

artworks.title: Les Vieux (The Elders)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground), spit bite, and roulette in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic interior scene surrounded by various sketches. The central image depicts a figure standing on a chair to reach high shelves within a decorative cabinet. Two other figures are nearby, and two small animals, possibly cats, are on the floor. Surrounding the central scene are smaller sketches, including a pastoral scene, a structure with two figures, a floral arrangement, a cat, a small building, and outlines of human figures. The composition is done with fine lines and hatching.
